entries.summary: K8 exports ./l-test-host (src/l-test-host.test-support.ts), an L test Host built only from the published packages: an embedded SQLite server, a paired daemon with a stub runtime that submits the result document, and the HostLedger. The K8 routine and delivery vectors run on it instead of the K4 openHost, so a Host that vendors K8 can run them too (#1325). The test Host changes no K8 rule; a Host that vendored K8 copies the new file with the two contract tests, as src/VENDOR.md Layer 3 lists. K8 also lets an external team snapshot mark a Bot participation: 'suspended' (#1319): the Bot stays in the team but takes no new work, its open work ends as for an archived Bot (delegation reason target_suspended, undelivered initiator_suspended), and input, answer and decide for it refuse with TeamModeError code bot_suspended. A later snapshot without the field restores it; a snapshot without the field behaves as before (README.md#external-team-authority). K8 also adds BotCollaboration.setModels(models) (#1357): construction and setModels re-project the Host's model templates onto every unarchived Bot by model name, keeping its device and profile; a frozen Turn keeps its execution. A missing template of an existing Bot no longer refuses a snapshot, update_bot, construction or setModels: each of the Bot's Turns blocks with Unavailable model: <name> before it freezes, in K8 and H, until the template returns (README.md#group-chat-and-main-bot). K8 also adds BotOptions.hostIntentMessages (#1356): an Agent message of a Host intent goes to the Host's message handler of the same name in the K4 message transaction, an accepted one is recorded without its body, and without a handler it still refuses with binding_mismatch; enqueueHostIntent and a restart refuse a messageEgress Host intent without a message handler. The K8 entry exports contextTurns, historyRowFromTurn, ContextTurn, HostIntentMessageHandler and MessageDisposition, and the delegation projection carries root (README.md#cross-bot-delegation). K8 also adds the owner command create_room (#1321): BotCollaboration.createRoom and HostedCommandEntry.createRoom create a room with a Host room id, and the same id with other fields is an identity_conflict. With rooms: 'external' (only with team: 'external'), each team snapshot carries the authority's room list; a room that it no longer lists is archived for good, and createRoom, updateRoom, setMemberMentions and the Main Bot's create_room and update_room refuse with TeamModeError code external_rooms. Without the option, behavior is unchanged (README.md#group-chat-and-main-bot). K8 also exports ./rules/message (src/rules/message.ts) for H's Host intent message handler (#1362); no K8 src change. A Host that vendored K8 copies the changed src/rules files, the changed Layer 2 files src/host.ts and src/index.ts, and the changed Layer 3 vector src/commit-vectors.test-support.ts. An outcome that breaks the bot-turn-outcome.v1 contract rules is now refused whole, and ask_user no longer has an action-level duplicate option id refusal (#1374).

Needs the next MINOR. ServiceDefinition.windows is the union ServiceWindowsOptions: { scope?: 'machine'; winswBin; installDir? } is the WinSW Windows Service as before, and { winswBin } still compiles; { scope: 'user'; stop: ServiceProgram } autostarts at the user's logon from a Startup .cmd and a batch launcher under <storeDir>\service, with no SCM registration and no administrator (#1337). stop() writes <name>.stopped, runs the Host's stop program and waits for the launcher to exit (service_unload_timeout); a stop program that exits non-zero is the new ServiceUnitError code service_stop_failed. A program value with ", % or a control character throws at construction. Code that reads def.windows.winswBin narrows on scope first. CreateServiceLifecycleOptions.deps also takes the user-scope test seams.

validateResultOutcome now takes ({ contract, schema }, outcome) and, for the SDK-defined bot-turn-outcome.v1 contract, runs its rules after the schema check: a repeated ask_user option id (duplicate-option-id) or a model string that is blank after trim() outside confirmable_action[*].draft (blank-text) fails with the new ResultOutcomeCheck reason contract-mismatch. The device refuses such an outcome on submit_result, so the model corrects it in the same Turn (#1374). A Host that calls validateResultOutcome directly passes its offer's contract id.
